answer: AI agents routing saffron freight and sonnet licensing resist Sybil attacks using stake-slashed security deposits. Each identity must lock liquid collateral in escrow, forfeited if validators prove protocol equivocation. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital opportunity cost of locking scarce financial reserves per identity. A primary limitation is that well-funded adversaries can echo their voting preference across multiple funded accounts once they surpass the collateral threshold.
